Rozalie, Ivanka pri Dunaji, June 1960, camera standing on the village green (~2.0 m) looking NNE across the green: horizon y 400, perspective s(y) = (y - 400) / 615 (hero 1.7 m = 512 px at y 1015, ~300 px per metre there; ~88 px per metre at the house fronts y 580). The Chapel of St Rosalia stands in the middle distance on the green (foot y 500); the ring of low tiled houses: the post-office house on the left (foot y 580), houses with lath fences on the right (foot y 585). Streets leave the square between the houses. Props stand where they are on a village green: the covered well on the grass in front of the post office, the bicycle leaning against the notice board on the right. The walk polygon is the green and the beaten-earth paths up to the dirt road in front of the houses, with lobes to the post-office door and the two street mouths; it leaves out the well, the notice board and the root base of the big linden on the right (v1 painting).
